answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can transact: honest work returns the bond, provable fraud slashes it. A sybil must fund every fake identity separately, so capital at risk climbs in a steep spiral instead of flattening. One attacker cannot cheaply hide a plume of clones in an ocean of honest peers, because doubling identities doubles locked collateral, making a forged majority economically ruinous.
